Title: Micronaut: DefaultHttpClient follows redirects, forwarding Authorization, Cookie, and Proxy-Authorization headers
Description:
> DefaultHttpClient follows redirects and forwards Authorization, Cookie, and Proxy-Authorization headers to redirect targets across domain boundaries. The blocklist only filters Host/Connection/TE/CT/CL.
> Additionally, no maximum redirect count exists, enabling infinite loop DoS.
> Affected: DefaultHttpClient.java lines 231-245, 1591, 2071

> Suggested fix: Strip sensitive headers on cross-domain redirects
AffectedVersions: All versions starting from 1.2.8 before 3.10.6, all versions starting from 4.0.0-M1 before 4.10.24, all versions starting from 5.0.0-M1 before 5.0.1
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.2.8, all versions starting from 3.10.6 before 4.0.0-M1, all versions starting from 4.10.24 before 5.0.0-M1, all versions starting from 5.0.1
